title: Ostrander retirement timing and pension election review
notes: The retirement date moves from December 31 to June 30, 2027, so the December-start 100% survivor figure ($3,855) and Glenn's first-choice single life figure ($4,180) are live distractors for the elected $3,655, and Lena's lump-sum rollover suggestion is declined. Patrice corrects her old 401(k) balance from $140,000 to $118,400 several minutes after stating it, the cash transfer is revised from $50,000 to $40,000, the Social Security statement task moves from Glenn to Patrice, and the pension PDF slips from Friday the 18th to Wednesday the 23rd. The transcription renders Kiran as "Karen" and the CPA as "Shimansky" before later turns clarify both, Lena's recap leaves out the Social Security statement, the $40,000 transfer, the CPA hand-off and the HR letter (Glenn adds back only the last), the rebalance is both account action a2 and Kiran's trade commitment i7, the 529, Roth conversions and lump sum must not surface as actions, and an adjudicator should treat the clients signing the DocuSign and Glenn returning the pension election form when the packet arrives in early January as acceptable implicit items, not hallucinations.
